controles.affirmation: La part du gouvernement dans le revenu etait de 56% au T1 2022
controles.verbatim_source: Source citee par l'ATT (.batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/PLTR.json), historiques trimestriels : GOV_REV Q1-2022 = 241,8 M$ et COMM_REV Q1-2022 = 204,6 M$, soit 54,2% du revenu total (446,4 M$). Aucune valeur de 56% dans la source.
controles.correction_proposee: Ecrire "elle etait de 54% au T1 2022" (241,8 M$ sur 446,4 M$). La valeur de 55% au T2 2025 est en revanche exacte (553 M$ sur 1 003,7 M$).

controles.affirmation: Les 1 005 000 actions Class F, logees dans un trust de vote etabli par Stephen Cohen, Alexander Karp et Peter Thiel, donnent aux fondateurs la capacite de controler jusqu'a 49,999999% des droits de vote tant qu'ils conservent au moins 100 millions de titres (environ 4% des 2,4 Mds d'actions)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "All shares of Class F common stock are held in a voting trust established by Stephen Cohen, Alexander Karp, and Peter Thiel (the “Founders”). The Class F common stock generally gives the Founders the ability to control up to 49.999999 % of the total voting power of the Company's capital stock, so long as the Founders and certain of their affiliates collectively meet a minimum ownership threshold, which was 100 million of the Company's equity securities as of June 30, 2026." Actions en circulation au 30 juin 2026 : 2 300 516 590 Class A + 101 375 151 Class B + 1 005 000 Class F = 2 402 896 741 (100 M = 4,2%)

controles.affirmation: Verrous statutaires : consentement ecrit des actionnaires impossible sans l'accord de la majorite des Class F, et seuil de 55% des votes pour certaines operations de changement de controle
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "prior to the Final Class F Conversion Date... the holders of our common stock will only be able to take action by written consent if the action also receives the affirmative consent of a majority of the outstanding shares of our Class F common stock" ; "certain transactions, other than restructuring transactions or transactions that otherwise do not involve a Change of Control... will require approval by the holders of at least 55.0% of the voting power of all of the outstanding shares of our capital stock entitled to vote thereon"

controles.affirmation: Le 10-Q identifie la dependance au CEO Alexander Karp comme un risque nomme
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 (facteurs de risque) : "If we are unable to hire, retain, train, and motivate qualified personnel and senior management, including Alexander Karp, one of our founders and our Chief Executive Officer... our business could suffer" ; "We are highly dependent on the continued contributions and customer relationships of our management, and particularly on the services of Alexander Karp"

controles.affirmation: Beaucoup de clients peuvent resilier pour convenance avant la fin du terme avec moins de douze mois de preavis ; le gouvernement federal americain ne peut exercer les options de contrat plus d'un an a l'avance ; Palantir n'a pas historiquement realise la totalite de la valeur affichee de ses contrats
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "the Company allows many of its customers to terminate contracts for convenience prior to the end of the stated term with less than twelve months' notice" ; "the U.S. federal government is prohibited from exercising contract options more than one year in advance" ; "We historically have not realized all of the revenue from the full deal value of our customer contracts, and we may not do so in the future."

controles.affirmation: Retards du processus budgetaire americain, resolutions de continuite et rupture des credits ont deja affecte et pourraient encore affecter la reconnaissance de revenu sur certains contrats publics
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "delays in the completion of the U.S. government's budgeting process, the use of continuing resolutions, and a potential lapse in appropriations, or similar events in other jurisdictions, have and could in the future adversely affect our ability to timely recognize revenue under certain government contracts"

controles.affirmation: Au T2 2026 le segment gouvernement genere 990 M$ sur 1 935 M$ de revenu total (51%), dont 809 M$ pour le gouvernement americain, en hausse de 79%
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : revenu gouvernement 990 032 k$ ; revenu total 1 935 464 k$ (51,2%) ; "Revenue from government customers increased by $437 million, or 79%" ; "Revenue from U.S. government customers was $809 million for the three months ended June 30, 2026 compared to $426 million for the same period in 2025"

controles.affirmation: Revenu T2 2026 de 1,94 Mds $ (+93%) et benefice net GAAP de 1,07 Mds $ ; S1 : revenu 3 568 M$, resultat net 1 942 M$
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : Revenue 1,935,464 / 3,568,047 ; "Revenue increased by $932 million, or 93%, for the three months ended June 30, 2026" ; Net income 1,065,962 (T2) / 1,942,364 (S1)

controles.affirmation: SBC de 265 M$ au T2 2026 (+66%) et 467 M$ au S1 (+48%) ; 1,4 Mds $ de charge non reconnue (916 M$ RSU, 361 M$ options, 136 M$ SARs)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total stock-based compensation expense $ 265,209 / $ 159,971 / 466,801 / 315,310" (soit +65,8% et +48,0%) ; "the total unrecognized stock-based compensation expense related to the RSUs outstanding was $ 916 million" ; "related to options and SARs outstanding was $ 361 million, and $ 136 million, respectively"

controles.affirmation: Actions diluees 2 569 M contre 2 400 M de base au T2 2026 (environ +7%) ; base en hausse d'environ 35 M sur un an (2 365 M au T2 2025)
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026, moyennes ponderees : basic 2,399,820 (vs 2,365,196) et diluted 2,568,694, soit +7,04% de dilution et +34,6 M d'actions de base

controles.affirmation: 80% du revenu du S1 2026 vient de clients americains ; les 20 premiers clients pesent en moyenne 124 M$ sur douze mois glissants ; Customer I represente 27% des 1,5 Mds $ de creances clients
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "In the six months ended June 30, 2026, we generated 80% of our revenue from customers in the United States and the remaining 20% from non-U.S. customers" ; "Our average revenue for the top twenty customers during the trailing twelve months ended June 30, 2026 was $124 million" ; "The Company's accounts receivable balances as of June 30, 2026 and December 31, 2025 were $ 1.5 billion and $ 1.0 billion... Customer I represented 27 % and 25 % of total accounts receivable"
